routes.independence: route B has no executable import of route A and imports only the standard library; the test parses its AST and asserts both. Route A buckets models by term vector, relabels partitions canonically and takes ceiling logarithms with int.bit_length; route B compares every pair directly, builds cells with a dictionary keyed on the code value, and decides the sign of a logarithmic combination by cross-multiplying its positive and negative parts into two integers.

in_flight_dependencies.why: AE12's register commit precedes every implementation blob of this package, which is what makes its W_DISC1 disagreement a genuine pre-registration for AE8 row 6. It is pinned by register digest rather than by the blob sha of a receipt, because both packages ship in the same change and a receipt regeneration must not break this workflow.

in_flight_dependencies.note: AE3, AE4 and AE7 are reconciled in the live issue comment but their packages are not on main at source_main (open pull requests #1033 and #1038), so they are NOT pinned by blob sha. The boundary facts this package needs from them are re-derived inside its own registered scope, so nothing here depends on an unmerged blob.

registered_scope.universe: the three-bit cube with the uniform measure
registered_scope.weight_grid: the 45 triples of eighths summing to 1
registered_scope.exact_arithmetic: Fraction and int only; irrational information quantities are carried as rational combinations of prime logarithms and compared by one integer product comparison, so no float and no numeric bound appears anywhere

disclosed_register_gaps: the register names `the frozen predicted disagreement sets` but does not enumerate them per world; the per-world disagreements are therefore reported as measurements, and the one preregistered discriminating world this package can point to is AE12's W_DISC1, whose register commit precedes every implementation blob here
